title: Cold Dew Solar Term
prompt: Describe the significance of the Cold Dew solar term in Chinese culture.
hint: Explain its impact on agriculture, food, and traditional festivals.
sample: The Cold Dew solar term marks the arrival of cooler weather and frost, influencing farming activities and inspiring traditional foods like crab soup dumplings. It also coincides with festivals such as the Chongyang festival, where people honor the elderly.
